guarantees.claim: When phase_sel_i equals MuBi4True, state_out = phase2_out; for MuBi4False or any other value (via default), state_out = phase1_out.

assumptions.claim: Controller driving phase_sel_i must correctly alternate between MuBi4False and MuBi4True according to the two-share masking protocol.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect or stuck phase selection could cause repeated exposure of the same share or mixing of shares, breaking side-channel resistance.

uncertain_points.claim: Default branch silently maps any illegal phase_sel_i value to phase1_out without error detection or alert.
uncertain_points.cond: phase_sel_i takes a value other than MuBi4False or MuBi4True
uncertain_points.risk: A fault that causes illegal phase_sel_i could go undetected, possibly leading to incorrect share selection and masked computation failures or leakage.
